tasks.label: build
tasks.command: [ -d build/meson-private ] || meson setup build; meson compile -C build

windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path build/meson-private)) { meson setup build }; meson compile -C build

tasks.label: test
tasks.command: [ -d build/meson-private ] || meson setup build; meson test -C build --print-errorlogs

windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path build/meson-private)) { meson setup build }; meson test -C build --print-errorlogs

tasks.label: reconfigure
tasks.command: meson setup --reconfigure build || meson setup build

windows.command: meson setup --reconfigure build; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { meson setup build }

tasks.label: clean rebuild
tasks.command: rm -rf build && meson setup build && meson compile -C build

windows.command: if (Test-Path build) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build }; meson setup build; meson compile -C build

tasks.label: use debug build (no optimisation)
tasks.command: [ -d build/meson-private ] || meson setup build; meson configure build -Dbuildtype=debug && meson compile -C build

windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path build/meson-private)) { meson setup build }; meson configure build -Dbuildtype=debug; meson compile -C build

tasks.label: use optimised build (default)
tasks.command: [ -d build/meson-private ] || meson setup build; meson configure build -Dbuildtype=debugoptimized && meson compile -C build

windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path build/meson-private)) { meson setup build }; meson configure build -Dbuildtype=debugoptimized; meson compile -C build
